title: Koszul Duality for Symmetric Algebras and Derived Loop Spaces
summary: In this paper, we prove Koszul duality for symmetric algebras of connective complexes consisting of locally free sheaves of finite rank, which is not necessarily bounded below. As an application, we construct an equivalence between derived categories of derived loop spaces and the symmetric algebra of the tangent complex for arbitrary separated schemes of finite type over a field $k$ of characteristic zero.
